event: A splashing sound occurs, and the task is to determine its location relative to a hypothetical robot standing by the stainless steel double wall oven and facing the kitchen hob.

sounding_object.description: A white ceramic mug with colorful dots, from which coffee is accidentally spilled by a man. The splashing sound is generated as the coffee impacts the wooden dining table. The sounding event occurs at the dining table.

reference_object.description: A set of two ovens stacked vertically, with stainless steel fronts, built into white kitchen cabinetry. Located on the right side of the main kitchen counter run (when viewed from the dining area).

facing_object.description: A gas cooktop with multiple burners, integrated into the kitchen counter, located to the left of the double wall oven along the same counter run.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the stainless steel double wall oven and facing the kitchen hob, when the splashing sound comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the sounding object: left, right, or back? If the object is generally to your left and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees left, choose 'left'. If the object is generally to your right and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees right, choose 'right'. If the object is generally behind you and facing it requires turning 120 degrees or more, choose 'back'.
